units.source_text: 女人拼命地清沙，目不旁顾。

en.t: The woman cleared away the sand desperately, without looking aside.

units.source_text: 男人躲在房子的角落，屏住呼吸瞧着，听着：

en.t: The man hid in a corner of the house, holding his breath as he watched and listened:

units.source_text: 轻松挥动铁锹的手臂动作……

en.t: the motion of her arms as she swung the shovel with ease...

units.source_text: 脚下的灯，映照出她那舞动的影子……

en.t: the lamp at her feet cast her dancing shadow...

units.source_text: 他牢牢抓住手巾的两端，用力往左右两边拉，

en.t: He gripped both ends of the towel tightly and pulled hard to either side,
then, after a few dozen more seconds, he would leap out...

units.source_text: 瞅准她用铁锹抄起沙子往上举，重心偏离的一瞬间，

en.t: waiting for the instant when she scooped up sand with the shovel, lifted it, and her center of gravity shifted,

units.source_text: 他想一步冲上去袭击她。

en.t: he meant to rush up in a single step and attack her.
